text: Rockstar Collector Editions comparison: - GTA 5: $150 with 6 items (game included) - Red Dead Redemption 2: $100 with 9 items (no game included) - GTA 6: $400 with 11 items (no game included) The GTA 6 Collector’s Edition is the most expensive mainly because of the Oakley sunglasses, which alone cost more than half the price of the bundle. @RockstarGames 😠
The “i” in Vice got damaged and is now missing the pink outline in the new GTA 6 sign. Rockstar paid $1 million for this btw @RockstarGames 😠

There are only 8 Thursdays left until the GTA 6 launch, so it’s reasonable to expect a new announcement every Thursday leading up to release. In fact, there has been a new announcement every Thursday since the Extended Look on August 27: - September 3: Limited Edition DualSense reveal - September 10: DualSense pre-orders - September 17: Album announcement and pre-orders On the last Thursday before release (November 12), pre-loading will begin. @RockstarGames 😠

Rockstar Games made it on live TV today, as the GTA 6 marketing kicks off in Miami. More signage is expected to appear after the deal was approved under the County Mayor’s delegated authority without any separate vote from commissioners, as some of them were surprised and opposed the idea. @RockstarGames 😠
